---
title: "Exploring Storms and Flights"
author: "Antigravity"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(nycflights13)
```

```{r}
#| label: storms-plot
#| cache: true

storms |> 
  distinct(year, name) |> 
  count(year) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Named Storms per Year",
    subtitle = "Data from the dplyr storms dataset",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Named Storms"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: flights

flights
```

```{r}
#| label: flights-plot

flights |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = dep_delay, y = arr_delay, color = carrier)) +
  geom_point()
```
